projects.description:
Invest Tech (LTIMindtree) 42 Months
Worked on the portfolio mamagement and reporting system for a leading financial services client. The project involved validating and enhancing data integrity for Asset Under Management (AUM) reporting, migrating
applications to AWS, and implementing UI upgrades from Kendo to AG-Grid. Responsibilities included designing and executing regression and functional test plans, validating AutoSys job workflows, and ensuring seamless data flow between databases and web applications.
